items.source:
Superinterface for all Advisors that are driven by a pointcut.
This covers nearly all advisors except introduction advisors,
for which method-level matching doesn't apply.
items.translation: 由切点驱动的所有 Advisor 的超级接口。这涵盖了几乎所有 Advisor，除了引入 Advisor，因为方法级匹配不适用于后者。

items.source: Get the Pointcut that drives this advisor.
items.translation: 获取驱动该 Advisor 的切面。
